items.sentence: Although the storm had stripped away several layers, the tree's bark still protected its trunk from insects.
Although the dog usually stayed quiet, it began to bark when unfamiliar footsteps approached the gate.
Although the waves forced the smaller boats to turn back, the coast guard managed to rescue two sailors before dark.
Although the crack was too small to see, the sensors could detect a change in pressure before the machine failed.
Although the bottles had been sealed, inspectors rejected the batch after tests revealed contamination inside several of them.
Although the patient felt well, doctors chose to isolate him until further tests ruled out an infectious disease.
Although the shortcut looked empty, Mina was cautious as she crossed the icy bridge, testing each step before moving on.
Although the builders had not yet opened the walls, they could estimate the repair cost from the visible damage and similar projects.
